1/ Cash Flow Brief, Oct 29 ☀️

The Fed held rates with two votes for a hike, and today's GDP, ECB and BOJ decisions could move your loan and savings rates.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: The Trump administration warned the Fed against a hike before the midterms. Warsh declined to answer Trump's call for lower rates.

Why it matters: Fed rates shape mortgage and savings costs.

Next: Watch if the December 9 decision draws more pressure.

3/ Economy: Q3 GDP (forecast 3.2%) and core PCE (0.3% m/m) land at 8:30 AM ET. The ECB decides at 9:15 AM.

Why it matters: Hotter inflation could keep loan and card rates high.

Next: If core PCE beats 0.3%, watch December hike talk heat up.

4/ 🏦 Fed: Held at 3.75% to 4%, 10-2 vote. Cook, Hammack wanted a hike. Inflation "remains elevated". Warsh said politics played no role.

Why it matters: High rates keep loan costs up.

Next: Watch December 9 for hike odds and new projections.

5/ Stocks: Tuesday's moves: LEU +11.2%, USAR +16.7%, MP +9.1%. I found no company news behind LEU or USAR.

Why it matters: Nuclear and rare earth stocks swing on policy and US-China news.

Next: Watch US-China headlines for this group's next move.

6/ Crypto: Bitcoin is near $80,033, down 1.6% in 24 hours. Strategy reports earnings today after pausing BTC buys.

Why it matters: Its pause removes a major steady buyer.

Next: Friday's ~$11.1B options expiry could add volatility.

Not financial advice.

1/ Cash Flow Brief: Evening, Oct 29 🌙

The Fed held rates with two votes for a hike, and today's GDP, PCE and ECB decisions could move your loan and savings rates.

What happened today and what to watch Friday 🧵

2/ Politics & world: A judge blocked a Medicaid 'medically frail' rule (Courthouse News). Netanyahu fell short of a parliamentary majority (AP).

Why it matters: Medicaid rules affect family health costs.

Tomorrow: Watch whether the administration appeals the ruling.

3/ Economy: US growth beat expectations (Semafor). Federal debt exceeds GDP, first since WWII (Washington Post). Why it matters: big debt can keep yields high; 10-yr is 4.99%. Tomorrow: 8:30 AM ECI, forecast 0.8%. Watch if wage costs cool.

4/ 🏦 What the Fed said:

• Held 3-3/4% to 4%. 10-2; Cook, Hammack wanted a hike.
• Inflation "remains elevated."
• Jobs kept pace with the workforce.
• Next decision Dec 9 (Admiral Markets).

Why it matters: Loan rates may stay high.

5/ Stocks: Nasdaq fell 1.4% to 26,188.00; S&P 500 slipped 0.3% to 7,721.02. Alphabet's worst day ever (IBD). Why it matters: tech drops can hit index funds and retirements. Tomorrow: Amazon earnings (per IBD) show if cloud growth steadies tech.

6/ Crypto: Bitcoin is at 78,712.62, down 3.1%. Ether is at 2,265.13, down 3.9%. Coinbase is profitable again (Motley Fool). Why it matters: crypto swings hit portfolios fast. Tomorrow: Does Bitcoin hold after the Fed? Not financial advice.
